description: The row of a sound's facts under its waveform, as parts: SoundLevel shows its peak, RMS or loudness with the others one click away, SoundRate its sample rate with the rates to resample to, SoundChannels its channels with the layouts to mix to (mono, stereo, 5.1, 7.1), and SoundReadout a plain value beside them. Controlled: the menus send the rate or the layout picked
name: sound-readouts
